payload.summary: Vendor-review remediation for PR #702. Grok found that a non-existent explicit --validation-report path bypassed the missing-report override; it now counts as missing, and the reason is stripped and the SKILL.md --force wording clarified.
completed_work: V1 explicit missing path counts as missing

decisions.title: A non-existent explicit path is a missing report
decisions.rationale: The spec gates the override on no report existing; an explicit path naming nothing is the same fact as an unprobed miss. A path that exists but is unreadable still fails as unreadable.

decisions.title: Defer a PermissionError test
decisions.rationale: Covered by the same except branch as tested cases; chmod tests are unreliable when CI runs as root.
